editorialSummary.heading: A one-day fall break and a holiday in the final week
highlights: November 20 is an early-release day before Thanksgiving break
Classes resume after winter break on Tuesday, January 5
February 15 is an early-release day, not a day off
paragraphs: Jefferson County School District students return Tuesday, August 11, 2026. The first nine-week grading period ends with early release on October 9. Students have no classes on October 12 for teacher inservice/planning, then a separate one-day fall break on Friday, October 23. November 20 is an early-release day before the November 23–27 Thanksgiving break.

December 17 is an early-release day and the last day of classes before winter break. Students have no classes from December 18, 2026, through January 4, 2027. December 18 and January 4 are teacher planning days; the district lists Winter Holidays for December 21–31 and January 1. Classes resume January 5. Students are off for Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, while February 15 (Presidents' Day) is an early-release school day.

The third grading period ends with early release on March 11. Students then have no classes on March 12 for teacher planning or during spring break, March 15–19. Classes are scheduled to resume March 22; March 26 is a separate Spring Holiday. May 19 and May 21 are early-release school days, with the May 20 Emancipation Day holiday between them. May 21 is also the last day of school. Dismissal times are not listed in the calendar.

faqs.question: When does school start and end in Jefferson County, Florida, for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Jefferson County School District students start Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and finish Friday, May 21, 2027. The last day is also an early-release day.

faqs.question: When is fall break in Jefferson County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Friday, October 23, 2026, giving students a three-day weekend. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, October 26. The teacher planning day on October 12 is a separate day off.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Jefferson County Schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes November 23–27, 2026, and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. Friday, November 20 is an early-release school day.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Winter holidays are listed for December 21–31, 2026, and January 1, 2027. Teacher planning days on December 18 and January 4 mean students have no classes from December 18 through January 4. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Jefferson County schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15–19, 2027. Students also have no classes March 12 for teacher planning, and classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 22. Friday, March 26 is a separate Spring Holiday, not part of spring break.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: There are eight: October 9, November 20 and December 17, 2026, and February 15, March 11, April 9, May 19 and May 21, 2027. These count as school days. The calendar does not specify dismissal times; check with your school.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents' Day, February 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jefferson County School District lists Monday, February 15 as an early-release day, not a day off. Students are scheduled to attend school, but the published calendar does not give a dismissal time.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes October 12 and December 18, 2026, or January 4 and March 12, 2027. The district lists these dates for teacher inservice/planning during the regular school year.

faqs.question: Is there school on Emancipation Day, May 20, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Thursday, May 20, 2027, is a districtwide Emancipation Day holiday. May 19 and May 21 are early-release school days, and May 21 is also the last day of school.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 9 and December 17, 2026, and March 11 and May 21, 2027. All four are early-release school days. The district calendar does not list report-card distribution dates.
